# Every place a figure's form is decided today, for tests/test_one_owner_of_number_forms.py, which says what a site is.
# One `<module> | <enclosing qualname> | <form> | <count>` per line, sorted. The module is relative to the package's
# src; the qualname is the enclosing definition (`<module>` at a Python module's top, `<top>` for a kit.js statement
# that declares nothing). A form is a primitive's or a wrapper's name, a spec's kind, or a kit.js call. A moved line
# keeps its entry; a new site, or one fewer, fails the ratchet.
#
# The list only shrinks. When a chunk routes a figure through analysis/report/forms.py, cut its entry to the count
# the tree now holds (drop it at 0). A new decision is never added: it routes through forms.py, and only C6 names a
# site permanently, in the test's _PERMANENT, with its reason. A line may be added only where it re-keys sites
# already counted, at no more sites than it takes away: a site a merged base moved from a form listed here into
# another form or function, or the callers of a renamed wrapper (a site's form is the wrapper's name, so a rename
# re-keys every caller).
#
# Generated from the tree on 2026-11-08 (evals/reset, nf-c3a merge); the ratchet, not this header, holds the counts.
# Grown once, on 2026-11-09 (C1b), from 606 to 672 sites: the walk learned to follow a figure handed through a
# helper that returns what it is given (with_unit's number_in, through _joined), a primitive stored in a table or
# bound to a name, and a property read through self. Those are sites the tree held already, newly seen; it shrinks
# from here as before.
